items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Henry told him about me... So he asked me would I want to go down to Seminole, Oklahoma. So I said, 'Why not? I ain't workin' here. I ain't makin' no money anyway.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Bill Powell. And he came in, and Henry told him about me, that I was a trumpet player. So he asked me would I want to go down to Seminole, Oklahoma. So I said, 'Why not? I ain't workin' here. I ain't makin' no money anyway.'
Now, where were you living at this time?
